brief:
A European Union diplomatic delegation toured Qassra to observe conditions of Palestinian families surrounded by settlers, the Ma'an news agency reported. The visit came as international pressure has mounted over restrictions on Palestinian movement and resource access in areas where settler activity has expanded.

The families described ongoing hardship resulting from the siege imposed by nearby settlers, including limitations on farming, commerce, and daily movement through surrounding land. Members of the delegation walked through affected neighborhoods and spoke with residents about their circumstances.

The EU delegation's visit represented a rare direct engagement between European officials and communities in the disputed territory affected by settler encroachment.
title: EU diplomats visit Palestinian families besieged by settlers in Qassra
